name: virlo
description: Give your AI agent a social media brain: TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels trend discovery, viral video analysis, creator lookups, trending sounds and hashtags, and niche research agents via Virlo's hosted MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Virlo is a research tool for short-form video. It answers three questions about TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels: what is trending in a niche, which videos are breaking out, and why they are working.

What you can do:

- Find emerging trends and breakout videos in any niche or topic.
- Analyze a single video and get a read on why it performed.
- Look up any creator: their outlier videos, posting cadence, and audience demographics and geography.
- Find trending and breakout sounds, trending hashtags, and the opening hooks that are working.
- Research a niche once, or set up a recurring agent that keeps watching it and reports what changed.

Results are ranked by how far a video outperformed its own creator's following rather than by raw view count, so a genuine breakout from a small account is not buried under a large account's baseline.

Who it is for: content marketers and social media managers, agencies, founders and creators publishing organic short-form video, and analysts who need short-form video data inside an existing workflow.

Limitations: Virlo reads and analyzes public short-form video data. It does not post, schedule, comment, or connect to your own social accounts, and it has no write access to any social platform. Coverage is TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and Meta Ads. Research agents run asynchronously: a run usually finishes collecting within about 20 minutes, and the written report follows a few minutes later. A Virlo account is required.
defaultPrompt: Use Virlo to find what is trending on TikTok in the home fitness niche this week.
Use Virlo to analyze this TikTok video and tell me why it went viral.
Use Virlo to look up this creator and show me their outlier videos and audience.
